Let’s get one thing straight before you panic: No, this is not a component for a Shielded Lagrange Annihilation Matrix, and no, it does not produce highly volatile, base-destroying antimatter. Despite its intimidating name, this device is simply an alchemical aggregator. Its sole purpose is to gather and centralize the raw EMC generated by your surrounding Energy Collectors. It bridges the gap between raw stellar energy and tangible matter generation.

Functionally, this entry-level relay acts as an energy buffer and director. It pulls EMC from adjacent Collectors and feeds it into items placed inside it (like an Alchemical Tome or Klein Star) or pushes it into an adjacent Energy Condenser.
A Crucial Rule: Relays cannot be used as conductive wires! They will not transfer EMC into another Relay. You cannot chain them together across your base.
Stats: It has a maximum output rate of 64 EMC per second and an internal storage buffer of 100,000 EMC.
